description: Changes a remote browser's name or URL; what you leave out keeps its stored value. To change the URL pass it in full: a URL with "***" in it is refused, since it would overwrite the stored token. Find the ID with listRemoteBrowsers.

includeSecrets.description: Return credentials in full instead of "***"; they then stay in the transcript. Default: false, or UPTIME_KUMA_INCLUDE_SECRETS.

remoteBrowserID.description: The ID of the remote browser to change

url.description: New ws:// or wss:// endpoint, in full

name: updateRemoteBrowser

url.description: WebSocket endpoint, e.g. ws://browserless:3000. Credentials in it read "***" unless includeSecrets is set

title: Update Remote Browser
